card.name: Confidence intervals in placebo comparisons
card.fires_on: Numbers and nearby words inside a 95% confidence interval reported for a drug versus placebo result. It also fires on words right after, such as "was" in "was not statistically significant".

modes.label: Digits in interval
modes.description: A digit inside the bracketed bounds of a 95% CI after a drug-versus-placebo estimate.

modes.label: Words around the interval
modes.description: Words such as "interval" or "was" next to a CI statement and its significance comment.
modes.example: but it<< was>> not statistically significant

card.plain: It marks the spot in a trial result where a confidence range for drug versus placebo is being given.
